scenicChapters.title: Estrada Nacional 2
scenicChapters.narrative: For 66 km this is Estrada Nacional 2, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Algarve Coastal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 40 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

algarve-coastal-route.story: A one-way ride of 210 km, Faro to Sagres - roughly 2 h 50 in the saddle. It goes by way of Albufeira, Carvoeiro and Lagos. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 16 km this is Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-church-of-the-presentation-of-the.story: From Bârsana it runs 87 km to Bârsana; allow about 1 h 30 of riding. On the way it passes Church of Saint Nicholas, Church of the Nativity of the Virgin and back through Church of Saint Nicholas. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

places-dlaboka-reka-decani-monastery-2.story: From Peshkopi it runs 279 km to Peshkopi; allow about 4 h 49 of riding. On the way it passes Church of the Virgin of Leviša, Dečani Monastery and back through Church of the Virgin of Leviša. The highest point is about 1,500 m. It crosses from North Macedonia into Kosovo - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
